choices: Which of the following statements best describes the mechanism of antibiotic resistance in bacteria?

Antibiotic resistance often arises from the acquisition of genes that enable bacteria to produce enzymes that inactivate antibiotics. This adaptation allows bacteria to survive and multiply in the presence of antibiotics.

questions.question: Which country hosted the first Youth Olympic Games in 2010?
questions.explanation: The first Youth Olympic Games took place in 2010 in Singapore. This event provided a new platform for young athletes to compete on an international level and was launched as a significant initiative by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
